title: Radioactive decay tracks seen coming off tall white suits

tellings.quote: So when I saw those coming off their the suits of the tall whites out in the desert, I knew perfectly well what they were.

plain: In 1965, in Indian Springs Valley in the Nevada desert, tracks of radioactive decay could be seen coming off the suits worn by tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites. That is the account of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years in the 1960s alongside these beings near the secret Air Force base known as Area 51. He tells Michels he saw this himself and "knew perfectly well what they were", which would mean the beings' suits gave off radiation.
